summary: Iteration 7 P0 fixes VERIFIED end-to-end: (1) duplicate video row on upload retry — FIXED; (2) upload aborted on SPA navigation — FIXED. Added 8 new backend tests in TestIter7Idempotency covering (a) duplicate final-chunk returns same video_id with idempotent=True and exactly 1 DB row, (b) storage_used incremented exactly once, (c) GET /videos/upload/status/{upload_id} for fresh/partial/completed states, (d) offset-retry does not double-write (2 chunks of 1KB with a retry yields 2KB not 3KB final file), (e) partial unique index 'uniq_user_upload_id' exists on db.videos with correct keys, (f) 403 gatekeeping preserved for no-plan users on /videos/upload/chunk, (g) 2 concurrent identical final-chunks yield exactly 1 row + same video_id. ALL 8/8 pass. Frontend UI: logged in as admin, uploaded a 15MB /tmp/big_test.mp4 via VideoManager, at 33% progress SPA-navigated to /dashboard/billings via sidebar button — global-upload-indicator was visible on Billings with filename 'big_test.mp4', progress advanced from 33% → 99% → completion WHILE ON THE BILLINGS PAGE (upload continued in background as designed), then SPA-navigated back to /dashboard/videos and exactly ONE big_test row was rendered in videos-grid with the success toast '✅ Ready for the stream! Plan validity: 346 days remaining'.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/videos/upload/chunk (479-662): idempotency correctly implemented — early-return on existing (user_id, upload_id) before AND after write, plus try/except InsertOne guarded by partial unique index. Offset truncation via `truncate(offset)` before append is correct and byte-safe on retries. Verified by test_offset_retry_does_not_double_write.

server.py partial unique index (line 1455-1458): partialFilterExpression uses {"upload_id": {"$type": "string"}}. Correct — excludes legacy rows without upload_id. Note: 'partialFilterExpression={upload_id:{$type:string}}' in the problem statement missed the closing brace but the actual code is correct.

UploadContext.jsx: correctly hoisted above <BrowserRouter> in App.js (line 21). runningRef/uploadIdRef are useRef so re-renders don't kill the upload loop. Chunks are sequential with 3× retry per chunk (1s,2s backoff), and beforeunload guard blocks accidental tab close.
GlobalUploadIndicator.jsx: renders when status!='idle' OR pendingResume set — correct. Renders 'Uploading' pane and 'Resume' banner as separate concerns.

VideoManager.jsx loadVideos() does client-side de-dupe by (upload_id || video_id) — defensive but wouldn't help if backend actually created duplicates. With the partial unique index now in place, the server-side dedupe is the source of truth.
Iteration-6 comment still applies: server.py is 1515 lines — recommend splitting into APIRouter modules.

Minor: /videos/upload/chunk response includes 'idempotent': true when short-circuiting, but the initial finalize success does NOT set it. That's fine but a client wanting to detect retries can only rely on the presence of the field.

Backend: /api/videos/upload/chunk is idempotent on (user_id, upload_id) — 8/8 new tests pass including a concurrent finalize race test. /api/videos/upload/status/{upload_id} correctly reports fresh/partial/completed states. rca of the issue: USER REPORT: (1) Duplicate video rows after upload, (2) Upload cancels on SPA navigation. RCA: (1) Previous chunked upload finalized (INSERT video row) and returned response; if network dropped the response, the client retried the final chunk which finalized AGAIN, inserting a second row + double-counting storage. Fix: server checks for existing (user_id, upload_id) BEFORE and DURING finalize, returns the existing row on retry, and a partial unique index prevents any race from persisting a duplicate. (2) VideoManager owned the upload promise via useState; navigating unmounted VideoManager and cancelled the axios request. Fix: hoisted state into <UploadProvider> above <BrowserRouter> in App.js — the provider never unmounts across SPA routes. Refs (runningRef, uploadIdRef) hold the running loop so it survives child re-renders. Also added resumability: server persists .part file per (user_id, upload_id) and exposes /videos/upload/status/{upload_id}; frontend writes upload metadata to localStorage ('liveadda:pending_upload_v1') so even a hard refresh can be resumed by re-selecting the file. Both fixes VERIFIED via 8 backend pytest tests + 1 end-to-end Playwright script (progress 33%→99% during SPA nav to Billings, exactly 1 row in videos-grid after).
